after.label: Require Approval for New Lines
after.desc: When on, new work order lines require approval. When off, they are auto-approved.

after.label: Require Review Before Completion
after.desc: Work orders must be reviewed and signed off before they can be completed

after.label: Require Tech Story
after.desc: Tech story will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order

after.label: Require Mileage
after.desc: Mileage will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order

after.label: Require Engine Hours
after.desc: Engine hours will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order

after.label: Require Ordering Parts
after.desc: When on, you click Order on each part to record that you've ordered it. When off, parts are marked as ordered automatically.

after.label: Require Receiving Parts Before Completion
after.desc: When on, each part must be recorded as received before the work order can be completed, reviewed or invoiced. When off, you can finish the work order and receive later.

after.label: Require Picking Inventory Parts
after.desc: When on, you click Pick on each inventory and found part to record that it's been pulled. When off, these parts are ready as soon as the line is approved.
